name: Barbedvow
description: Bow to the foe and settle with one javelin forward and the other held back at the hip.

name: Inferno Launch
description: Throw the forward javelin level and bring the second hand at once to the same line.

name: Plumevoyage
description: Advance one foot and one shaft together so the pair never falls out of time.

name: Dartcrown
description: Lead with the left hand and echo with the right so the second shaft follows with qi behind it.

name: Squall Thinheft
description: Cross both shafts to catch a blade between them and hold it still for a heartbeat.

name: Millstone Throwloop
description: Rap both points on the foe's striking arm to numb it and quiet its answer.

name: Triumphant Loft
description: Throw both shafts wide so that the foe's guard parts to meet them and leaves the centre open.

name: Harmonious Dropdive
description: Chain a thrust and a cast and a recovery so that the guard opens a little more each time.

name: Radiance Whistle
description: Drive both points to the foe at once so one finds the guard and the other finds the body.

name: Magnificent Prism Skewerflight
description: The school's own throw in which both shafts leave on one beat and pin the foe's guard open as they strike.

name: Revelation Leadknob
description: Settle on a high perch and hold still until the whole field below is understood.

name: Thunderclap Dart
description: Tuck the leading shoulder as the body drops and let the arm unfold into the throw.

name: Dartsolace
description: Land from a drop with a rolling step that turns the fall into a forward pace.

name: Solar Tailweight
description: Draw qi upward through the body as height is gained and hold it ready for the dive.

name: Fletchmercy
description: Lock the gaze and a thread of qi on one mark so the dive cannot be turned aside.

name: Quenched Launch
description: Throw down from a height so that the barbed point sets deep in the target.

name: Nightmare Fletch
description: Pass over the foe's head so the shadow draws his eyes upward and away from the real throw.

name: Valiant Loft
description: Add the full weight of the fall to a plunging throw that bites through a shield.

name: Orchestral Whistle
description: Dive and throw and spring back up to height and dive again without touching the ground long.

name: Gallant Skewerflight
description: Fall without a sound from beyond the foe's sight and strike before he knows he is hunted.

name: Peerless Vacuum Dropdive
description: The school's own cast in which the thrower hangs at the top of a leap and drops with the shaft as one.

name: Leadseal
description: Hold the breath low in the belly like water in a basin while the shaft guards the front.

name: Launchverdict
description: Let the arm hang loose and heavy and then lob the shaft up in a soft high arc.

name: Loftgrace
description: Slip forward with a low smooth pace that gives the foe no sharp motion to catch.

name: Bloom Pointbalance
description: Fill the belly with qi to the brim and carry it unspilled to the shaft.

name: Vigor Dartcap
description: Follow a thrown shaft in at a run and thrust with the second in a single flowing line.

name: Pulsar Whistle
description: Tip the shoulder and let the qi spill sideways out of the arm into a throw that curves.

name: Resonant Dart
description: Throw with the pooled qi and follow the flight in at once with a thrust of the second shaft.

name: Thunderclap Leadknob
description: Drag the butt along the ground and sweep the foe's feet away like silt from a riverbed.

name: Dauntless Dartpoint
description: Cast with the whole pooled reserve at once so that it breaks a guard like a flood breaks a bank.

name: Imperial Whistle
description: The school's own stroke in which the pooled throw and the flowing thrust arrive as a single motion.

name: Steel Pointbalance
description: Hold the stance that keeps both the far throw and the near thrust ready at once.

name: Radiance Loft
description: Open the fight with a high lob along the far track to draw the foe's guard up.

name: Fletchedict
description: Prick the foe's lead hand with the spare point on the near track while his eyes are high.

name: Launchboon
description: Sidestep across the line between the two tracks so the foe cannot tell which is next.

name: Pall Fletch
description: Shift from far track to near in the middle of a beat to spoil the foe's reading.

name: Deluge Lightshaft
description: Catch the foe's thrown shaft on one javelin and let the other send it back.

name: Lordly Launch
description: Throw one shaft and thrust with the other inside a single breath so both tracks land together.

name: Loftbanner
description: Drive forward with both points low and steady and press the foe back one pace at a time.

name: Noble Dropdive
description: Throw on both tracks so that the shafts close from front and flank at the same moment.

name: Entropy Throwloop
description: Pry at the guard from both tracks in turn until the foe cannot defend either one.

name: Illustrious Whistle
description: Spend both shafts and all the qi of both arms in one piercing stroke at the foe's centre.

name: Royal Skewerflight
description: The school's own stroke that fuses the far throw and the near thrust into one beat of the court.

name: Statute Dartpoint
description: Stand tall at the crown of the body with the shaft held high and the point angled forward.

name: Barbedtriumph
description: Throw in a high even arc that peaks above the head of the foe and falls steeply.

name: Fletchgrace
description: Place each foot as lightly as on a mirror of water so the step makes no ripple.

name: Plumegift
description: Raise qi from the soles to the crown and let it pour down the arm into the shaft.

name: Heroic Dart
description: Thrust in one flowing line from the crown of the stance to the foe's belt.

name: Thunderclap Skewerflight
description: Cast along a line as level as the horizon and let qi hold the shaft true on it.

name: Leadpledge
description: Wheel the shaft over the crown of the head to sweep aside every blow from above.

name: Solar Dropdive
description: Throw the shaft high so its qi falls back as a river of force over the ground.

name: Grand Whistle
description: Pursue a retreating foe with a throw and a leap and a second throw from the air.

name: Fearless Throwloop
description: Pour the whole of the gathered qi down the shaft so it falls like a column of water.

name: Exalted Steel Dart
description: The school's own cast that joins the hawk's height to the river's flow in a single crowning throw.

name: Plumetroth
description: Settle into the apex stance with both shafts crossed low and the chin lifted.

name: Nucleus Launch
description: Root the feet and cast overhand from the centre of the body in one level pull.

name: Barbedmercy
description: Draw both shafts from the back in a single motion and feel their weights match.

name: Dartboon
description: Leap straight upward to take a hawk's height for the next throw.

name: Intrepid Loft
description: Feed both shafts from the one formed Core so that they leave with matched force.

name: Volition Tailweight
description: Stretch qi out along both arms to lengthen the reach of every thrust and cast.

name: Revered Leadknob
description: Parry with both shafts fed from the Core so that the blow is thrown back the way it came.

name: Thrall Dartpoint
description: Pin the foe's cloak to the ground with a thrown shaft so that he cannot rise freely.

name: Famed Skewerflight
description: Pierce with both points on one line so the second drives the first deeper.

name: Tempestuous Dropdive
description: Spend a long breath of Core qi and loose a volley that falls from the whole sky.

name: Plumedecree
description: Strike from the edge of the Core's reserve with a hawk's speed and a hawk's aim.

name: Paramount Dartcap
description: The school's highest throw in which both shafts fall as one from a hawk's height on a sworn mark.

name: Fletchseal
description: Take the oath aloud and stand on the plateau with the shaft held across the chest.

name: Leadedict
description: Hurl the shaft on a straight line as plain as the word that was sworn.

name: Launchsolace
description: Pace the open ground at an even length until the mark stands at the sworn distance.

name: Vigor Throwloop
description: Hold the breath and the oath together while qi gathers in the drawing arm.

name: Squall Dropdive
description: Lean out over the plateau's edge to add the whole height of the drop to the cast.

name: Peal Leadknob
description: Turn the shaft so a blow parts around the oath-bearer and spends itself on air.

name: Venom Dartcap
description: Pin a foe's trailing cloak with a thrown shaft to hold him on the sworn line.

name: Storied Fletch
description: Throw with the oath's full weight and qi behind a short heavy shaft that breaks a guard.

name: Symphonic Launch
description: Hold the line with a thrust and a throw and a step back and repeat without breaking.

name: Triumphant Dartcap
description: Cast with the oath struck on the breath so the point finds the mark through any guard.

name: Valiant Quenched Throwloop
description: The school's own cast along the sworn line that carries the oath and holds the thrower's ground.

name: Plumebanner
description: Draw the shaft from the bundle at a run and throw before the stride is done.

name: Squall Dartcap
description: Sidestep to the quarter the wind comes from and stay out of the foe's line.

name: Leadvow
description: Drop into a low crouch behind the shaft so that the body offers a small mark.

name: Vaunted Whistle
description: Cast on the run with qi along the shaft and let the wind carry it past a swerving foe.

name: Loftvoyage
description: Weave through the gusts in short steps that are never in the same place twice.

name: Leadverdict
description: Turn the head and shoulder mid-run and throw back at a pursuer without halting.

name: Splendid Dart
description: Run in a wide curve and loose shaft after shaft at the foe from every quarter.

name: Choral Dropdive
description: Chase a fleeing foe with a cast and a leap and a thrust at the heel in one run.

name: Matchless Loft
description: Add the speed of the whole run to a thrust so the point passes through a raised shield.

name: Fearless Launch
description: The school's own cast in which the thrower hurls at the very top of a gale-driven run.

name: Interstice Lightshaft
description: Set the lead shoulder square to the mark and take the bearing from it.

name: Dartdecree
description: Draw the shaft back along the bearing without letting the elbow leave the line.

name: Loftodyssey
description: Mark the bearing with each footfall so that the body advances on a single line.

name: Plumebenison
description: Lead a moving mark by the width of a hand for each pace it takes.

name: Prism Dropdive
description: Cast with qi locked to the bearing so the wind cannot push the flight off it.

name: Peal Thinheft
description: Turn the wrist a hair at release to cancel the drift the wind will add.

name: Pall Dartpoint
description: Parry with the shaft while the feet hold the bearing so the thrower never turns from the mark.

name: Imperious Throwloop
description: Plant a thrown shaft upright on the bearing so the foe must go round it or through it.

name: Triumphant Skewerflight
description: Pierce at long range on a bearing held so true that the shaft needs no correction.

name: Majestic Launch
description: Throw three shafts down one bearing so each follows the groove the last has made.

name: Lordly Dartpoint
description: Hold the bearing through the whole motion and strike with every ounce of weight on the line.

name: Sovereign Pulsar Launch
description: The school's own cast that keeps the sworn bearing from first draw to the moment the point lands.

name: Prism Lightshaft
description: Stand where no cover exists and present only the point and a narrow shoulder to the foe.

name: Barbedcrown
description: Hurl across a wide plateau with a long step and a full swing of the arm.

name: Fletchodyssey
description: Plant each foot flat on bare stone so that no step can slip at the moment of the throw.

name: Parity Thinheft
description: Draw qi from the open air and the stone beneath to make up for the absence of cover.

name: Pulsar Loft
description: Duck under an incoming shaft and throw from the crouch before standing again.

name: Deluge Dartpoint
description: Turn the shaft across the body to knock a flying spear down into the dust.

name: Phantasm Whistle
description: Kick a cloud of plateau dust upward and throw through it where the foe cannot see.

name: Inviolate Pointbalance
description: Plant the butt and meet a charge head-on so the point takes the foe's own speed.

name: Thunderclap Dropdive
description: Throw while rolling across open ground and rise to throw again from a new place.

name: Lordly Dart
description: Cast at the open sky's height so that the point falls on the foe from beyond his guard.

name: Royal Launch
description: The school's own cast that turns the thrower's lack of cover into the strength of the throw itself.

name: Consecrated Throwloop
description: Settle into the stance sworn to the gale with the shaft held at the shoulder.

name: Fletchcrown
description: Breathe the oath out slowly as the arm draws back and the shaft comes level.

name: Leadgift
description: Glance at the edge of a distant cloud to fix the bearing of the throw.

name: Bloom Fletch
description: Draw the gale's push into the arm as qi until the whole body hums with it.

name: Radiance Dart
description: Let the oath carry the cast far beyond the distance the bare arm could reach.

name: Squall Throwloop
description: Wheel the shaft in the gale's own turn so that blows slide away along the spin.

name: Intrepid Dropdive
description: Drive the shaft on the full strength of the sworn gale through shield and plate together.

name: Resonant Launch
description: Link a long cast and a run and a second cast so that the oath reaches the mark twice.

name: Majestic Whistle
description: Pierce a distant foe on a line the gale itself holds steady and straight.

name: Exalted Quenched Skewerflight
description: The school's own cast in which the sworn word and the gale carry the shaft over any distance.

name: Nucleus Pointbalance
description: Settle into the last stance of the school with the bearing fixed and the shaft level.

name: Kernel Launch
description: Root the draw in the body's centre and let the gale's push rise into the arm.

name: Barbedbenison
description: Take the breath that closes the oath and hold it until the shaft has gone.

name: Plumeboon
description: Find firm footing at the edge of a storm and keep it through every shift of the wind.

name: Pulsar Dropdive
description: Feed the cast from the formed Core so that it flies with the weight of a storm.

name: Parity Dartcap
description: Wheel the shaft with Core qi so that the storm's own spin takes the blow away.

name: Eclipse Tailweight
description: Read every shift of the wind with Core sense and set the last bearing by it.

name: Barbedgrace
description: Slip into the shadow of a storm cloud and come out of it on the foe's open side.

name: Heroic Whistle
description: Pierce with Core qi and the storm's weight so that nothing short of a hill can stop it.

name: Demolition Loft
description: Hold the bearing through a long draw and loose a hailing volley along its whole length.

name: Fearless Dartpoint
description: Gather a storm's force into one shaft and strike with it on the bearing before it can scatter.

name: Magnificent Skewerflight
description: The school's last throw in which the storm and the sworn bearing arrive together on one mark.
